messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands facing the camera, then begins walking forward and slightly to her left, turning her head to look over her shoulder before continuing to walk away.","camera":"A static, full-body shot from a slightly low angle, capturing the subject from head to toe against the background.","clothing":"She wears a sleeveless white crop top with a black floral pattern, high-waisted teal-green wide-leg trousers, a black choker, and dark strappy sandals.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Short, voluminous blue hair styled in a tousled, swept-back cut.","identity":"A young woman with a slim build, light skin, and a visible face, shown in a 3D-rendered style.","scene":"An outdoor paved area, likely a parking lot or road, with white lane markings, a metal guardrail, red-and-yellow striped bollards, and a concrete wall in the background under bright sunlight."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from an industrial stone platform with wooden pallets and pipes to the reference paved road scene with white lane markings, metal guardrail, red-and-yellow bollards, and concrete wall. The character’s blue hair, crop top, green trousers, choker, sandals, walking action, and full-body framing remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change the scene to the reference environment (paved road/parking area with guardrail, bollards, and concrete wall), keeping the same person, blue hair, outfit, expression, action, camera framing/movement, and natural lighting.
uncertain: Whether the character’s facial expression was preserved exactly throughout the sequence.
unexpected_changes: The character’s shadow appears much darker and sharper in the output than in the source.
